text: Mainly Instagram and Telegram. Telegram is where most of my life happens — group chats with classmates, news channels and even my university announcements. Instagram I use more for fun, mostly to follow photographers and a few friends who post interesting things about their travels.

tips.en: Each app has its own role, so the answer is precise.
tips.kk: Әр қолданбаның өз рөлі бар — жауап дәл.
tips.ru: У каждого приложения своя роль — ответ точный.
tips.example: Telegram is where most of my life happens

tips.en: Instagram I use… puts the object first, which sounds lively.
tips.kk: Instagram I use… — толықтауыш алға шығарылған, бұл жанды естіледі.
tips.ru: Instagram I use… — дополнение вынесено вперёд, это звучит живо.
tips.example: Instagram I use more for fun

questions.followUp: What do you use them for?
questions.question: Which social media apps do you use most?

text: More than I'd like to admit. My phone says it's around three hours a day, although a lot of that is messaging rather than scrolling. I've recently set a one-hour limit on Instagram, and I'm surprised how quickly I stopped missing it.

tips.en: More than I'd like to admit and the phone's figure make the answer honest and specific.
tips.kk: More than I'd like to admit және телефондағы дерек — шынайы әрі нақты.
tips.ru: More than I'd like to admit и данные телефона — искренне и конкретно.
tips.example: My phone says it's around three hours a day

tips.en: Although … rather than clarifies what the time is spent on.
tips.kk: Although … rather than уақыт неге кететінін нақтылайды.
tips.ru: Although … rather than уточняет, на что уходит время.
tips.example: although a lot of that is messaging rather than scrolling

phrases.text: More than I'd like to admit

questions.followUp: Do you think it's too much?
questions.question: How much time do you spend on social media each day?

text: Not really. I'm quite a private person, so I share maybe one photo a month, usually of a trip or a nice meal. I prefer sending things directly to close friends, because I don't feel comfortable with hundreds of people, some of whom I barely know, looking at my personal life.

tips.en: I'm quite a private person explains everything that follows.
tips.kk: I'm quite a private person одан кейінгінің бәрін түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: I'm quite a private person объясняет всё, что дальше.

tips.en: Some of whom is a relative clause that shows higher-level grammar.
tips.kk: Some of whom — whom бар бағыныңқы сөйлем, жоғары балл белгісі.
tips.ru: Some of whom — придаточное с whom, признак высокого балла.
tips.example: some of whom I barely know

questions.question: Do you post much about your own life online?

text: Quite a lot, yes, mostly from Telegram channels, because they're fast. The downside is that rumours spread just as quickly as real news, so if something sounds shocking, I try to check it on an official news site before I believe it or share it with anyone.

tips.en: Speed is the upside, rumours the downside — a balanced answer.
tips.kk: Жылдамдық — артықшылық, өсек-аяң — кемшілік: теңгерімді жауап.
tips.ru: Скорость — плюс, слухи — минус: сбалансированный ответ.
tips.example: The downside is that rumours spread just as quickly as real news

tips.en: What the speaker actually does keeps the answer concrete.
tips.kk: Сөйлеушінің өзі не істейтіні — жауап дерексіз болып қалмайды.
tips.ru: Что делает сам говорящий — ответ не остаётся абстрактным.
tips.example: I try to check it on an official news site

questions.question: Do you get news from social media?

text: It's a mixed blessing. On the one hand, teenagers can find communities and learn things that aren't taught at school. On the other hand, constantly comparing yourself with perfect photos can really damage your confidence. I think the key is teaching kids how it works, not just banning it.

tips.en: On the one hand … On the other hand gives a clear structure.
tips.kk: On the one hand … On the other hand — анық құрылым.
tips.ru: On the one hand … On the other hand — чёткая структура.
tips.example: On the one hand, teenagers can find communities

tips.en: The key is… gives a conclusion, not just a list.
tips.kk: The key is… — жай тізім емес, қорытынды.
tips.ru: The key is… — вывод, а не просто перечисление.
tips.example: I think the key is teaching kids how it works

note.en: “Make you feel less sure of yourself”.

questions.question: Do you think social media is good for young people?
